result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two answers are nearly identical in layout, grouping and controls: both put listening settings first, use segmented controls, switches and a select, and say that changes save automatically. A shows the current value of every visible setting in place, including the 'Off' label under crossfade and 'Default' beside text size. In B's screenshot no text size value is shown, though B's full-width crossfade slider is easier to tap. The reset option is cut off in both screenshots, so I couldn't judge item 4 and scored it equally for both. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two screens are nearly identical: they use the same grouping, auto-save messaging, segmented control for quality, crossfade slider, sleep timer select and switches. B is slightly ahead because it labels values in place ("Balanced · about 96 kbps", crossfade "Off", text size "Default"), while A's text size value is cut off below the fold. The reset section is off-screen in both screenshots, so how well each separates and scopes reset can't be confirmed.
